title: The popular version. Instagram was a giant that Facebook swallowed.
description:
Instagram was a giant that Facebook swallowed. It was a three year old company with 13 employees.

The number of employees at Instagram when Facebook agreed to buy it in April 2012.

About $1 billion in cash and stock. NPR attributes the figure to Forbes. Al Jazeera reports it as $1bn.

That is roughly $77 million for every employee. This is $1 billion divided by 13, rounded.

More than 25 million people already used it. That is the user figure Al Jazeera gave.

The deal landed just weeks before Facebook's IPO. NPR reported it as coming just weeks before the share sale.

Thirteen people, one app, and a billion dollars.

Sources:
- https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2012/4/10/facebook-updates-status-with-instagram-deal (read): dated 10 April 2012; Facebook spent $1bn to buy a smartphone app called Instagram; described as a three-year-old company with 13 employees; more than 25 million users.
- https://www.npr.org/sections/thetwo-way/2012/04/09/150292381/facebook-is-buying-instagram (read): NPR: price approximately $1 billion in stock and cash per Forbes; 13 employees per TechCrunch; the deal came just weeks before Facebook's IPO.
